accessibility.contrast_body_b: . Umbala awulokhu uthatha incazelo wedwa — isimo ngasinye sihlanganisa igama noma isithombe sombala waso, futhi amalayeri emaphu asebenzisa uhlu lwemibala lwengu-Wong oluvikelekile kubantu abangaboni imibala.
accessibility.feedback_before: Uma kukhona noma yini lapha enzima ukuyibona, ukuyisebenzisa, noma ukuyiqonda, lokho kuyiphutha ekwakhiweni kohlelo — likhiphele ku
accessibility.feedback_cite: Ukuvota nokuba umkhethwa akudingi lutho ngaphandle kokuhlala endaweni ovotela kuyo — i-interface akufanele yengeze izithiyo ozivimbela umthethosisekelo · Art. I
accessibility.feedback_mid: ukuze kulungiswe ngaphambi kokuba ukwakhiwa kokukhiqizwa kukuthathe. Ungakwazi futhi
accessibility.focus_body: Indilinga yegolide engama-pixel ama-3 ikhombisa ukugxilisa kulo lonke ulawulo; ngaphansi kwemibala yokuphambana ye-Windows leyo outline ibonakala ngombala we-system highlight. I-sticky chrome ibeka isikhala sokuskrola ukuze into egxilile ingalokhu ifihliwe ngemuva kwayo.
accessibility.i18n_body: Konke ukuhlelwa kusebenzisa izakhiwo ze-CSS logical ukuze izilimi ezivela kwesokunye kuya kwesokunxele zibe yikhophi yesibuko efanele (shintsha isiqoqo ezilawulweni ze-Demo ukuze uhlole); ishintshi solimi sisekhala ekhanda lakho kuyo yonke ikhasi; i-pseudo-locale enokunwebeka kombhalo ngo-35% iyingxenye yethuluzi le-QA.
accessibility.intro: Ukumela wonke omunye wethu kusho i-interface wonke omunye wethu angayisebenzisa — ngokwemikhono, ulimi, isiqoqo sombhalo, idivayisi, nokuxhumana. Lesi sithombe sibamba isayithi yohlelo uqobo futhi siqopha isivumelwano sokufinyeleleka okuthathwa ukwakhiwa kokukhiqizwa.
accessibility.keyboard_body: Konke ukusebenzisana kusebenza ngaphandle kwe-pointer: i-skip link iyinto yokuqala egxilile kuyo yonke ikhasi, izimenu zekhanda ziyizinto zokuvula zomdabu (Escape ziyazivala), iphepha lokuvota elihleliwe lisebenzisa izinkinobho zokunyakazisa kunokuhlela ngokudonsa kuphela, futhi izindlela zokuhamba ziyizinkinobho nezixhumanisi ezilula.
accessibility.limit_copy: Umbhalo womzimba wekhasi uza ngesiNgisi; ishintshi se-locale ihumusha i-application chrome kuphela. Ukwakhiwa kokukhiqizwa kukhipha wonke umbhalo ngokusetshenziswa i-ICU MessageFormat catalog ngokuhlelo lokuhambisana nemizweltu.
accessibility.limit_demo: Izilawuli ze-Demo ekhasini ngalinye ziyithuluzi lokubonisa, aziyona ingxenye yesivumelwano sohlelo.
accessibility.limit_map: Ama-pane emaphu ahleliwe (indawo yegunya browser, district mapper) ziyizindawo zokubeka ze-Leaflet viewers ezithuthukiswayo; yinye ngayinye inencazelo yombhalo, futhi ipaneli eliseduze ikhombisa idatha efanayo njengombhalo. Ama-viewers okukhiqizwa azofika nokuhamba ngokuphelele kwekhibhodi nezinto ezifana nombhalo.
accessibility.limit_testing: Ukuhlolwa okuzenzakalelayo nokwakhiwe kuhamba kuyo yonke ikhasi lale sayithi; ukuhamba kwezobuchwepheshe bokusiza nabahloli abantu (screen reader, switch, voice control) kuhlelelwe ukwakhiwa kokukhiqizwa, hhayi lezi ziboniso ezizimele.
accessibility.motion_body_a: Izinto ezinyakazayo zingaphansi kwe-300ms, akukho okukhanyazayo, futhi
accessibility.offline_body: Amafonti agcinwe thina (SIL OFL 1.1) futhi akukho nsiza elandwa kunoma iyiphi isevisi yangaphandle — isayithi isebenza ngokuphelele ku-LAN ngaphandle kokuxhumana ne-internet, kuhardweer olunamandla aphansi.
accessibility.reflow_body: Ukuhlelwa kugcinwa kusukela kuma-320 CSS pixels (nangokuzoma kuka-400%) kuze kube kufoni, tablet, nama-monitor amakhulu, portrait noma landscape, ngaphandle kokuskrola ngokuhamba kwesandla nokungakhiwa kokujikeleza.
accessibility.review_line: Umqondo: WCAG 2.2 Level AA, nezinye ze-Level AAA · EN 301 549 · ihlolwe okugcina 2026-06-11
accessibility.structure_body: Ikhasi ngalinye limemezela ulimi lalo, linisihloko esikhethekile, i-h1 eyodwa, amazinga ama-heading ahleliwe, nesethi ephelele yezindawo (banner, navigation, main, contentinfo); izibuyekezo zesimo zimemezelwa ngendawo ephilayo enenhlonipho.
accessibility.timeouts_body: Izikhathi zomthethosisekelo kulezi zikrini ziyiziboniso ezifakwe — akukho lutho kule sayithi yesiboniso oluphela noma oluqhubeka ngokuzenzakalelayo.
accessibility.touch_body: Izinto ezisebenzisanayo zinganiyi-24×24 CSS pixels kuhlanganise nezilawuli ze-chip ezincane.
amendments.about: Lesi sikrini sikhombisa izindlela ezimbili umthethosisekelo ongashintsha ngazo — isango sezilungiselelo lihamba ngokushintsha kwezilungiselelo ezingashintshwa nange-ordinary bill flow, futhi konke ukushintsha kukhiwa ekhasini lokucwaninga. Izilungiselelo ezingashintshwa zihlelwe ngokwe-indawo yegunya; ukuqinisekisa kukhuphuka ngokusetshenziswa iningi elikhethekile lomvoti. Ngamazwi onjiniyela, igama eliqinile liwuhlu lwemifayela evikelekile egcinwe yi-constitutional test suite — ukukhishwa kwenzeka kuphela lapho i-suite ephelele iphumelela.
amendments.check_out_range: {value} kumele kube phakathi kwezibalo — injini izokwenqaba lokhu ngaphambi kokuvota (okuvumelekile {min} – {max}).
amendments.current_body_a: Okukhiyelele konke okungashintshwa njengamanje emsulwini we-instance, nomngcele oqinile okumele kuhlale kuwo, nesinqumo esishintshe lokhu okugcina. Izixazululo zihlukaniswe ngokwe-indawo yegunya — lokhu isithombe se-instance yonke; irejista ephelele eqondiswe ngokulandelana kutholakala ku-
amendments.door_one_body: Izethingi umthethosisekelo ozishiyela indawo yegunya ngayinye, ezishintshwa isinqumo esishayamthetho esivumelekile (ushintsho lwesethingi olungashintshwa) ngendlela ejwayelekile yomthethosivivinywa. Injini ivimba izibalo ezingaphandle komngcele ngaphambi kokuba ukhetho uhlelelwe. Konke ushintsho olusebenzisayo lufika lapha, irekhodini eliphilayo — liyengezwa, alukhi shamu.
amendments.door_two_body_a: Imishini lapho isinqumo, iphaneli yokuphatha, noma ihhovisi okungeke kuthinte. Ushintsho lapha ukukhipha kwesoftware entsha okumele idlule kuzo zonke izihlolo zomthethosisekelo ezizenzakalelayo ngaphambi kokuba ithunyelwe —
amendments.door_two_body_b: , obala, ushintsho nokuhlolo lwalo kurekhodi lomphakathi.
amendments.door_two_body_strong: ukunciphisa amandla kwenzeka kuphela ngalo mnyango
amendments.floor_body_a: Ingxenye yeningi elikhethekile ingashintshwa, kodwa incazelo yayo inezansi eliqinile: akukho ukuncazela kabusha okungakhiqiza umngcele ophansi kwe-
amendments.floor_body_b: yazo zonke izilungu ezisebenza. Okujwayelekile kungathathu, okubalwa njenge-
amendments.floor_gloss: Iningi elikhethekile, incazelo: isabelwana saso sonke isilungu esihlala esihlalweni — izihlalo ezingenamuntu zisabizwa ekubaleni kwamanani kuze kube yilapho zigcwaliswa — ngakho ukungabikho akukwazi ukwehlisa izinga.
amendments.intro: Umthethosisekelo ushintsha ngeminyango emibili kuphela. Izethingi owushiyile zishintsha ngamanqumo ejwayelekile esishayamthetho, phakathi komngcele ovunyelwe. Inyoni eqinile (igama eliqinile) ishintsha kuphela ngokukhipha kwesoftware entsha, okwenziwa obala lapho zonke izihlolo zomthethosisekelo zidlula obala. Akukho okushintsha ngokuthula, futhi akukho okushintsha ngendlela eyodwa.
amendments.ledger_caption: Ushintsho lwesethingi olungashintshwa olusebenzisayo, okusha kuqala
amendments.no_amendments: Akukho zinguquko okwamanje — konke ushintsho luzovela lapha, luyengezwa, alukhi shamu.
amendments.ratify_article_threshold: Iningi elikhethekile lezindawo zegunya ezingabavoti — noma iningi elikhethekile lesishayamthetho lapho kungekho bavoti
amendments.ratify_hardened_threshold: Ukukhishwa kwe-software yomphakathi lapho zonke izinhlololo zomthethosisekelo ziphazile
amendments.ratify_within_threshold: Isinqumo esemthethweni sesishayamthetho (iningi noma iningi elikhethekile ngokwesetingi)
amendments.rule_cgc_ip: Impahla yengqondo yeNkampani Yenhlalakahle Yomphakathi ihlala isemhlabeni womphakathi
amendments.rule_districts: Izifunda zezihlalo ezi-5–9 — igumbi elingaphezu kwe-9 lihlukaniseka ezifundeni; isizinda segumbi ngokwalo asinalo isilinganiso esiphezulu
amendments.rule_quorum: Ikhoramu neningi elikhethekile kubalwa ngokwemalungu wonke asebenza
amendments.rule_residency: Ukuvota nokuba umkhethwa: ukuhlala kuphela, azikho ezinye izimiso
amendments.rule_secrecy: Imfihlo yephepha lokuvota — ubuntu buhlukaniswe ngokwe-cryptography
amendments.rule_voting: Ukuvota okuhambisana nesibalo se-Droop quota — hhayi ukuvota kokuqala noma okuningi
amendments.try_body: Isiqondiso sokuvota kuphela. I-engine iqhuba uhlololo lwemingcele efanayo ohlangothini lweseva lapho umthethosivivinywa wokulungisa ufayilwa — lo mshini awenzi lutho.
atlas.dir_gloss: Ama-server agcina i-mesh isaphila, nabahlali abawusebenzisayo. Vula uphathayo ukuze ufinyelele ku-profile yabo yomphakathi.
atlas.econ_lead: Imali iyisifundo sokubala esibukekile — azikho izindlela zokukhokha, akukho ukugcinwa kwemali. I-wallet iyimfihlo, njengephepha lokuvota.
atlas.growth_note: Ukukhula nokufika kuboniswa ukuze kugiyiswe ukubamba iqhaza nokugcina inethiwekhi iqiniseka — hhayi njengesikhali sokuthinta amalungelo Omanikazi.
atlas.intro: Isikrini esisodwa somdlalo wonke: imephu ephilayo yayo yonke ikhono, indawo, inhlangano, nomhlali ovumile — kanye nezimpawu zokumelewa, ubulungiswa, umnotho, kanye ne-mesh. Impilo yomhlaba, nabo bonke abadlala.
atlas.land_note: Umhlaba uyisikhizelo esilula esidwebiwe sokulondolozwa. Izikhundla zingezizinga ledolobha futhi zibandakanyisa.
atlas.living_map_gloss: Yonke ikhono, indawo, inhlangano, nomhlali ovumile emhlabeni owodwa. Izikhundla ezibandakanyisa kuphela — lokhu ukulondolozwa, hhayi ukulandela.
atlas.mesh_lead: Kuphathwa abazisebenzi — ukugcina umhlaba uxhumekile ku-inthenethi akuthengi ukuvota naphakathi kwesihlalo. Uma i-node eyodwa isaphila, umhlaba usaphila.
atlas.no_rollup_body: Isithombe somhlaba sasemini asikaqali kuleli-instance, ngakho izimpawu zokuphila zibonakala njengezikhala hhayi njengezinhlamvu zikazero.
atlas.optin_said: Manje ubonakala njenge-pixel eyodwa — ebambelele ku-grid, engenalo igama.
atlas.people_lead: Izinto ezifeziwe zomuntu ngumuntu ziyimfihlo ngokuzenzekelele futhi azinikiwo ubuholi obuthandayo — zihlukaniswe ngokuphelele namavoti, izihlalo, nemali.
atlas.reach_gloss_a: Ukufika ukuhlangana kwendawo eqinisekisiwe nekhona. Kuyi
atlas.reach_gloss_strong: isilinganiso sokubambezeleka sokubona kuphela — akulona okungena ekubuseni
atlas.reach_no_nights: Azikafiki izinsuku ezilinganisiwe ezanele zokukhipha itrend. Ibusuku obugcinwe buyisikhala, hhayi uzero.
atlas.rollup_footer: Izimpawu ezibalulekile zokuhlanganiswa komhlaba kwasebusuku · {when}. I-Atlas ifunda isithombe, hhayi ukubala okuqondile komhlaba.
atlas.simulated_body: Lezi zimpawu ezibalulekile zesibonelo sokuzivocavoca, hhayi isizwe esiphilayo.
audit_chain.about_p1: I-hash yemininingwane ngayinye ihlanganisa i-hash yemininingwane edlule kanye nemininingwane yayo, okwenza ushintsho lubonakale. Izicelo ezenqelwe nawo zibhalwa, kanye nesizathu sokwenqelwa. Imininingwane esekhona ayikwazi ukulungiswa noma isuswe.
audit_chain.about_p2: Lolu hlelo lukhombisa imininingwane eshicilelwe. Alivezi imininingwane eyisisekelo noma ubuyena babahlanganyeli. Izinombolo zilandelelano zingaba nezikhala, ngakho inombolo yokugcina ayikona ukubala kwemininingwane.
audit_chain.about_p3c: Ukuqinisekisa ngokuphelele kubala kabusha izingakoliso; ukubuka isitambu asikuqinisekisanga.
audit_chain.empty_page: Ayikho imininingwane kule khasi. Buka umlando wakamuva ukuze uhlole amarekhodi amasha.
audit_chain.intro: Buka izenzo ezirekhodiwe uvule isitambu semininingwane ethile.
audit_chain.invalid: Le nombolo yemininingwane ayisebenzi. Sebenzisa inombolo ephelele eyinhle noma ubuke umlando wakamuva.
audit_chain.invalid_cursor: Leli xhasi lomlando alisebenzi. Buka umlando wakamuva ukuze uqhubeke.
audit_chain.load_failed: Umlando awukwazanga ukulayidwa. Zama futhi noma ubuyele emininingwaneni yakamuva.
audit_chain.missing: Imininingwane #{seq} ayitholakali kule instance. Izinombolo zilandelelano zingaba nezikhala.
audit_chain.recompute_note: Kubala kabusha isingakoliso ngasinye. Lokhu kungathatha isikhathi kule instance enkulu.
audit_chain.reconcile_note: Kubonakala ukuphazamiseka, akukaze kubhalwe kabusha: i-operator e-de-facto isayina ukuvuma ngesizathu, kurekhodwe ku-chain, bese ukuqinisekisa kubona ukuhlukana njengokusekelwe.
audit_chain.verify_operator: Ukuqinisekisa i-chain ephelele kubala kabusha yonke i-link futhi kuqaliswa yi-operator; imiphumela irekhodwa lapho isebenza.
clocks.about: Ishedyula uqobo lwayo iyinjini ngemuva kokuhambisana kwesikhathi nokuphikelelwa kokuhlangana kwezinsuku ezingu-90. Le khasi lihamba njengespec yeshedyula — ishedyula yokusebenza isebenzisa leziirekhodi zewashi, umugqa owodwa, umthombo owodwa wokuqala. Izinto ezivamisele ezishintshwayo zishintsha ngesinqumo sesishayamthetho; izikhathi eziqinile nezobume zizibophelwe kukodi. Izikhathi zazo azinawo isimo — zihambisa ezinye izinto (ukukhetho, amandla esimo esiphuthumayo, izihlalo ezingenamuntu, izicelo zokuhlala) ezigabeni zazo.
clocks.family_deadlines_desc: Ukubala phansi, izikhathi zokuphela ezishintshayo, namafasitela anemikhawulo noma aqhubekayo.
clocks.family_thresholds_desc: Ababheki kwezinani — abantu, isibalo sabantu, izigwebo, izihlalo.
clocks.glossary: Uhlu lwamagama: ikhoramu lapha ihleka bonke amalungu asebenza, hhayi kuphela labo abakhona; i-Droop quota ukubala kwamavoti okuncane kakhulu okuqinisekisa isihlalo ngokwemibalo; isibalo sabaphilisi bephepha lokuvota sikhula ngokwezihlalo emncintiswaneni.
clocks.intro: Ukuhlanza okuhleliwe okuqhuba umhlaba — zonke izikhathi, izikhathi zokuphela, amafasitela, nemingcele eqala inqubo ngaphandle kokuba kube nomuntu ocela. Isikhathi nesibalo sabantu yikona okuvusa; izikhulu azikwenzi lokhu, futhi akukho lapha okudinga umuntu ukuba akukhumbule.
clocks.playtest_body: Kudonsa zonke izikhathi zokuphela ezibhalisiwe esikhathini esiseduze esikhundleni sokuthinta iwashi — kufakwa irekhodi lokucwaninga njengesenzo somthuthukisi, ukuzama okungashintshi okubonakala ngaphambi kokuba kube nokunye okuhamba.
clocks.reading_amendable_body: kusho ukuthi isinqumo esemthethweni sesishayamthetho singashintsha okujwayelekile ngaphansi kwemikhawulo egcothwe — bheka
clocks.reading_live_body: yilokho okubambile isihleli njengamanje — izikhathi ezivuswe nesikhathi sokuphela sangempela esiseduze, ngqo etafuleni tezikhathi.
clocks.reading_type_body: yisivumelwano sesihleli: izikhathi eziphindaphindwayo zivuswa futhi lapho zishaya; ukubala phansi kuphela kanye; amafasitela ayavuleka futhi avalwe; imingcele ibheka inani bese ivuswa lapho lidlula umngcele.
constitutional_questions.about_a: Inothi elisekuhlangothini laseduze kwendawo yokulungisa, hhayi umnyango wesibili wokulungisa. Ukulungiswa kohlelo olusebenzayo kuhamba ngeminyango emibili ku-
constitutional_questions.about_b: ; leli bhuku liqopha imibuzo engacacile emthethosisekelo nezimpendulo ezisetshenziswe ekwakheni (WF-SYS-05).
constitutional_questions.how_lands_a: Umbuzo uba yisimo lapho umbhalo womthethosisekelo ungawuchazi kahle uhlelo olumele lunqume luhlelo lwe-software — bese ukwakha ukhetha impendulo. Ungenangena ubhala kuphela ingxenye yombhalo ethintikile, uveze impendulo esebenzisayo ogudanini olulodwa, futhi uchaze izindawo lapho impendulo ibonakala khona. Wonke
constitutional_questions.how_lands_b: umaki lapho yonke indawo kuhlelo uxhumana nendawo yawo lapha
constitutional_questions.intro_a: Izindawo lapho ukwakha umdlalo kwenza ukuba kuthathwe isinqumo okungazange kwenziwe emibhalweni yomthethosisekelo. Lokhu kuyikhaya lezinkulumo ze- "kungani" ezivulekile — ukungena ngamunye kubhala umbuzo, impendulo ekhethiwe ekwakheni, nokuthi kuvela kuphi ukusebenza kwayo. Wonke
constitutional_questions.intro_b: umaki ku-app uxhumana lapha, futhi uhlu lonke luyisisekelo somklamo olandelayo ka
constitutional_questions.ledger_body: Okungeniswe kwengezwa njengoba ukwakha kuveza imibuzo emisha; okukhona sekweyezwa kuphela, akukho okubhalwa kabusha. Ukungena ngamunye kubhala umbhalo womthethosisekelo othintwe, okukhombiswe ukuzama kukwakha, impendulo esetshenzisiwe, kanye nesibonakaliso sesimo esikhombisa ukuhamba kwayo eya ekubhalweni kabusha kwemva komdlalo.
constitutional_questions.q1_answer_b: kanye nokusekela okuqondile — noma iyiphi inhlangano
constitutional_questions.q1_answer_c: ingasekela noma yimuphi umkhethwa; amalungu angenayo inhlangano eyawasekelayo amaqala ezingeni elifanayo.
constitutional_questions.q1_touches: Kuthinta: izinhlelo zokuvota okulingana (proportional) · ukuphepha nokwethembeka kokukhetho · amakomiti · ukwakheka nokukhethwa kwamakomiti esigungu esiphethe
constitutional_questions.q1_where: iphepha lokuvota elivulekile lihlunga ngokusekela kwenhlangano noma ukusekela komuntu ngaphandle kokuba nokholamu yeqembu noma kuphi; izikhombiso zekomiti zikhombisa ukuthi ukulingana kuhlala kukhonjiswa ngokusekela kuphela. Isimo sokubuka nokucwaninga ngesikhathi sokubala sidluliselwa ezinhlangan원으로 ezisekelayo nakubamakhethwa uqobo lwabo.
constitutional_questions.q2_answer: ukulingana kwama-voti kuya kumphathi wesihlalo onesha elikhulu lama-voti ngemuva kokulungisa ama-quota — kugcine ukulingana okukhiqizwe ukukhetho lwe-STV kanye nomuntu oyedwa ivoti eyodwa, ngaphandle kwesigaba seqembu.
constitutional_questions.q2_h: 2 · Ukuxazulula ukulingana kwekomiti — isabelo samavoti se-quota elilungisiwe
constitutional_questions.q2_surfaced: ukuxazulula ukulingana komthethosisekelo ("umsebenzi we-voti yokukhetha kokuqala komalu ngasinye ekukhethweni okwedlule") kucabanga ukuthi izibalo zokukhetha kokuqala zingafaniswa — kodwa ukudluliselwa kwe-quota kwe-STV kwenza zingafaniseki phakathi kwabanqobi.
constitutional_questions.q2_where: ukuhamba kokabela ikomiti — isabelo samavoti elilungisiwe somalu ngamunye sibonakala eduze kokuxazulula ukulingana ukuze izibalo zicwaningwe ngeso.
constitutional_questions.q3_answer_a: umthetho wosayizi wesishayamthetho (v1: cube-root kuphela) — izihlalo zisonke =
constitutional_questions.q3_answer_b: ngaphezulu koxhumano lwabantwana baqondile, ngaphandle komkhawulo wezihlalo zisonke. Imithetho ehamba phambili eyahlukile igcinwe.
constitutional_questions.q3_surfaced: umthethosisekelo unika isifunda (izihlalo ezi-5–9) kodwa uthule ngokuthi izihlalo ezabelwe ngokwemizabalazo zombuso zibe zingaki isishayamthetho esikhulu ngokuhlala.
constitutional_questions.q3_touches: Kuthinta: amabhodi okukhetho azimele (ezihlalo ezi-5 ezincane / ezi-9 eziningi ngesifunda + isigaba)
constitutional_questions.q3_where: ummapha wesifunda uthola isabelomali sezihlalo zonke emthethweni wosayizi futhi ukhombisa i-quota (abantu ÷ izihlalo) eduze kwayo. Esikhaleni somhlaba umthetho ukhiqiza izihlalo ezi-1,999 ezabelwe ngokwemizabalazo ezifundeni ezi-282 — inombolo umbhalo womthethosisekelo ongake waba nayo.
constitutional_questions.q4_answer_a: izifunda ziyizinhlanganiso zezindawo zegunya zabantwana baqondile, zonke zingaphakathi kobangela womthethosisekelo wezihlalo ezi-5–9, zakhiwe emigqeni yegunya yangempela — hhayi imizobo yokuzikhethela, futhi hhayi indlela yencwadi. Izihlalo zigeleza ekubeni nokwabelwa okukhulu: isibalo se-cube-root sasekamaleni sihlukaniseka kubantwana ngokwesabelo sabantu (isibalo sabantwana siyisikhombiso); umntwana osebelo wakhe ongadlula umkhawulo ugcina ekubeni yisibalo esiseduze kakhulu ngaso Articles, futhi isabelomali sakhe kuhlelwa kabusha phakathi kwabanye, isigaba ngesigaba. Izifunda ezidwebiwe bese zilungiswa ku
constitutional_questions.q4_answer_b: isibalo esizimele — usayizi wekamala ugcinitwe, ngakho udwebo lapho izihlalo zalo zingafiki esabelomali se-pool kuyiphutha okumele udwebwe kabusha, hhayi ukulungiswa okuphoqelekile. Lapho indawo yegunya idlula umkhawulo ngaphandle kwezigaba zabantwana edataset, imigqala yesifunda kumele idwebwe ngesandla — imingcele evulekile.
constitutional_questions.q4_h: 4 · Ukuhlukanisa izifunda — izinhlanganiso zezindawo zegunya zabantwana
constitutional_questions.q4_surfaced: ukudweba imigqala ngokuzikhethela kulwa nokubambisana komphakathi nokucwaningeka — futhi ayikho indlela yokwabelana yencwadi (Webster, Sainte-Laguë, largest-remainder) egcina izibalo zezihlalo zithembeke osayizini wekamala owabekwa ngqo umthetho we-cube-root.
constitutional_questions.q4_touches: Kuthinta: amabhodi okukhetho azimele ("adwebwe ngokulingana, ngokulandelana, nangokulunga") · ukuhlukanisa izishayamthetho
constitutional_questions.q4_where: ummapha wesifunda ukhombisa amapulani okulungisa / asebenzayo / agcinwe nezihlalo ezilungisiwe eziseduze, izinkomba zokulandelana nokubambisana, kanye nezibalo zamaqembu angcono kakhulu / angaphansi / amanje; ukuqapha kwebhodi lokukhetho kuhamba nge-console yebhodi. Ayikho isigaba se-Webster noma i-Sainte-Laguë noma kuphi ekwabelweni.
constitutional_questions.q5_answer: ukukhetho kwezigaba ezimbili: ukuvuma okuqhubekayo → ukunciphisa kwabafinalisti → isikhathi esibekelwe ukuhlunga → i-PR-STV eyodwa yokubala (i-Droop quota, ukudluliselwa kwe-Gregory fractional) egcwalisa zonke izihlalo ngesifunda.
constitutional_questions.q5_h: 5 · Ukukhetho kwezigaba ezimbili kwephepha lokuvota elivulekile
constitutional_questions.q5_surfaced: isigaba sokuvuma esiqhubekayo nesihlungiseka (esivuleka ngomzuzu okukhethwa kweminyaka edlule okuqinisekiswa ngayo) nesigaba sabafinalisti (ama-X phezulu ngomncintiswano, okulingana nosayizi wesihlalo) kwenza isiqinisekiso sokulungelo lokumela ukusebenza ezibalweni zabakhethwa bomhlaba wonke — kanti ukubhala noma yimuphi umkhethwa oqinisekiswe kugcina ilungelo ngokuphelele.
constitutional_questions.q5_touches: Kuthinta: ilungelo lokuvota nokumela ukukhetho · ilungelo lokumela isikhundla
constitutional_questions.q5_where: iphepha lokuvota elivulekile (umugqa wabafinalisti, ukuvuma okungashintshwa, izinguquko zokuncintisana) kanye nephepha lokuvota elihlungwe nalo elihlala likhona ukubhala noma yimuphi umkhethwa oqinisekiswe.
constitutional_questions.q6_answer: ukubala kabusha kuhamba yonke indawo — amaphepha lokuvota okukhetho okwedlule abalwa kabusha kukhishwe ilungu elishiyile njengomkhethwa, ngaphandle kokuhlunga amaqembu noma kuphi enqubweni. Ukuhluleka kusasele ukuba kube nokukhetho okukhethekile phakathi kwezinsuku ezi-90–180.
constitutional_questions.q6_surfaced: inqubo yokubala kabusha ibheke egabeni lezifaktion — futhi ngezifaktion zithathwe yizimvume ezinohlobo oluhlukahlukileyo (entry #1), izingxenye zenqubo ezihambisana nezifaktion azisasebenzi.
constitutional_questions.q6_touches: Kuthinta: inqubo yokubala kabusha yokugcwalisa isihlalo esingenamuntu
constitutional_questions.q6_where: ukubuka injini yokubala kabusha nokuhamba kwayo.
constitutional_questions.q7_answer: uhlobo ngalunye kumele lhlangaze ikhoramu yalo futhi liphumelele ngokuzimela — iningi lalo LONKE amalungu asebenza alolo hlobo (iningi elikhethekile lapho isinqumo sikudinga). Kumele kuxazululwe embhalweni womthethosisekelo.
constitutional_questions.q7_h: 7 · Isivumelwano esimbili semisebenzi yamakhamu amabili — umngcele wohlobo ngalunye
constitutional_questions.q7_surfaced: umthetho udinga ukuthi zombili izinhlobo zamalungu zivumelane ngokuzimela kodwa awubali nomngcele noma ikhoramu yohlobo ngalunye. Inhloso wukugcina izingxenye ezilinganayo nezingxenye ezihambisana nomphakathi ngaphandle kwemingcele ekhona yesistimu yesizwe-isimo, kudingeka isivumelwano esimbili.
constitutional_questions.q7_touches: Kuthinta: isivumelwano esizimelayo sezenzo zesishayamthetho · ukuxhumanisa isidingo sekhoramu ekulungisweni kwamalungu aphelele
constitutional_questions.q7_where: izilinganiso zesivumelwano esimbili emincane yomthethosivivinywa (ukushintsha kwamakhama amabili).
constitutional_questions.read_template_a: — umbhalo womthombo lo leda eliqala ukubuyisela kokubhala kabusha.
constitutional_questions.status_legend_a: — kuphakanyiswe ekubhalweni kabusha kwangemuva komdlalo ka
constitutional_questions.status_legend_b: namabhuku omsebenzi. Izincwadi ezamukelwe ukubhalwa kabusha zizogunyazwa kabusha kunokuba zisuswe, ukuze kugcinwe umlando wombuzo.

translation_review.terms_gloss_a: Lawu magama anesisindo somthetho futhi kumele afundeke ngokufanayo yonke indawo. Qinisekisa kuqala: yonke isihloko esine lolu gama silandela isinqumo, futhi ukushintsha igama kamuva kuphutha zonke izinqumo ezenziwe ngamagama amadala.

translations.add_langs_profile: Yengeza izilimi ozifundayo kuphrofayili yakho ukuze uqale ukuqinisekisa — uhlu lolu lugcinwe kubafundi ukuze ukuhunyushwa kuqinisekiswe kuphela abantu abangakwazi ukukuhlulela.
translations.add_language_body: Awuboni olwakho? Noma yiluphi lwezilimi ezi-{n} ezibhalwe phansi lungavulwa ukuhunyushwa, futhi olusha lungacelwa. Umshini udweba zonke izinhlobo zokuqukethwe kanye, bese uyavulwa ukuze ubuyekeze — alithunyelwa njengokugcina kuze kube yilapho abafundi bekuqinisekisa.
translations.all_carried: Ulimi lonke olubhalwe phansi luthwele yonke imilayezo.
translations.by_namespace_note: Imilayezo ngendawo yesekelwe, nokuthi zingaki ulimi luluthwele. Isikhala simaphela efolder yikhasi.
translations.can_verify: Ungaqinisekisa — khetha ulimi ukuze usebenze uhlu lwalo, okubi kuqala:
translations.code_c2: Ikhiyi ikhona olimini kodwa ayikho esiNgisini
translations.findings_run_b: ukuthola imininingwane ngesihluthulelo ngemuva kwalo lonke ikhodi.
translations.gate_passes: Igeyimu iyadlula. Azikho izilimi ezisele futhi yonke imilayezo ihlangana.
translations.halt_note: Abasebenzi bayema esigabeni sabo esilandelayo esivunyelwe — okukodwa kuphela okwenza kabusha.
translations.intro_a: Ukuba ngakanani kwalolu hlelo umuntu angakufunda ngolimi lwakhe. Yonke imizalo ngezansi ikhiqizwa igeyimu yokuhumusha
translations.intro_b: — ukuhamba okufanayo okuvimba ukwakhiwa lapho ulimi lusala emuva. Akukho okukuleli khasi okukalelwe ngendlela yesibili.
translations.matrix_gloss_a: Izinhlobo ezintathu zokuqukethwe ngolimi. Iselula ikhombisa ukuthi kuqedwe kangakanani nokuthi ikuphi emjikelezweni.
translations.matrix_gloss_d: ezinekhatalogi kule nsizakalo zikhonjiswe — imigqa yezinhlamvu ezincane kwesinye singazifihla lezi.
translations.not_measured_b: futhi iphuma ngokungaphansi kwero-zero lapho ulimi lusale emuva.
translations.not_measured_body: Ayikho imikhiqizo yokugubuzelwa kule nsizakalo. Qhuba igeyimu ukuze ukhiqize eyodwa:
translations.operator_note: Njengomsebenzi ungakwazi ukuqinisekisa zonke izilimi — sebenzisa lokhu ukuze uvule ulandelelo olungakafikwa ngumfundi, hhayi ukuze uchithe abafundi bolimi.
translations.overall_note: Okubanzi kuwukuhlanganyela kwezinhlobo zizintathu, ngakho ezine esingakazikhiqizi zikuhlehla. Lokhu kuhleliwe: ulimi aluhunyushwe ngoba izinkinobho zalo zihunyushwe.
translations.pkg_export_hint: Khetha ulimi. I-zip inama-khatalogi aphelele alolo ulimi: ahunyushwe lapho kukhona, isiNgisi lapho kungekho, kukhona i-README yezibalo nemithetho. Noma thumela i-English master, okuyikona okungumthombo.
translations.pkg_import_hint: Fundisa i-zip ehunyushwe, noma ifayela elilodwa kuyo, bese unikeza ulimi lwayo igama. Iserba siyihlola kuqala sikhombise lokho okuzovunyelwa, lokho okuzongelwa ngoba akuzange kushintshe, nalokho okuzonqenwa, ngaphambi kokuba kubhalwe noma yini. IsiNgisi asingeniswa neze.
translations.pkg_intro: Uhlelo olulodwa lwolimi lonke, kuhlanganise isiNgisi: README.txt, ui/<namespace>.json kanye ne-php/<code>.json, wonke amafayela aphelele. Iphakheji eqondiswe kuyo ithwele ukuhunyushwa okuhlelo noma isiNgisi lapho kungekho; i-English master iyimthombo uqobo. Humusha noma kuphi, besengenisa i-zip ngaphansi kolimi lwayo. Isenzo ngasinye sisebenza njengomsebenzi obekwe emgqeni, hhayi ekhasini.
translations.pkg_request_hint: Bhala ulimi olungakavulwa muntu. Luvela ohlwini olungaphansi.
translations.pkg_state_line: Kuhlelo manje: IsiNgisi (umthombo, izinhlamvu ezi-{keys} emafayileni e-{files}), izidrafti zomshini ezi-{present} zisasebenza, izilimi ezi-{absent} ezibhaliswe kodwa zingenazo izinhlamvu okwamanje.
translations.same_english_body: izibalo zifana ncamashi nomthombo — igama eliqondile elingahunyushwa, noma inhlamvu engakavulwa muntu. Lokhu kuyisikhombiso sabahlolayo, hhayi ukuhluleka.

translations.sop1_detail: Noma yiziphi zezilimi ezibhaliswe {n}, noma ucele entsha.
translations.sop2_detail: Umshini ubhala konke kanye — abantu abaqali nasebhokisini elingenalutho.
translations.sop3_detail: Abafundi bolimi olulowo babona imidwebo futhi baqala ukuqinisekisa.
translations.sop4_detail: Umsindo uqiniseka lapho abafundi abanele bavumelana futhi isango sihlanzekile.
translations.sop_private: Irekhodi ezimfihlo azingeniswa nakancane — ukuhlola idatha kuvimbela lokho.
translations.sop_verified: Kuqinisekisiwe ngabantu abafunda i-interface ngolulimi, hhayi ngumshini ozigradela.
translations.verifier_gloss: Noma ubani ofunda ulimi angaqinisekisa ukuhunyushwa kwalo. Umdwebo uqiniseka ngokwekhoramu yabafundi abavumelana — umshini awuzishicileli. Izilimi ozifundayo zivela ku-akhawunti yakho futhi zinikeza isisindo ekucinisekiseni kwakho.
translations.worker_note: Umsebenzi ngamunye uphethe ikhophi yakhe yemodeli yokuhumusha, ngakho i-GPU — hhayi i-CPU — isetha ukuthi zingaki ezingasebenza kanye. Umsebenzi uhambisana ngama-batch amancane: ukuma, noma ukuphuka, kubiza i-batch eyodwa kakhulu futhi akushiyi ulimi olungaqediwe.
